Name: MMMMP - Mute My Main Menu Please
Author: Arshia1381
Description:
[size=4][b]Super straightforward, exactly what it sounds like.[/b][/size]
[size=4]Fixes a longstanding bug with the mute button and audio logic in the main menu.
The main menu would play music despite the mute button in the top left being selected if you changed menu pages, and the logo would not accurately reflect muting.

This mod is a super simple fix to that (the actual patch logic is less than 200 lines of code)
[url=https://github.com/ArshiaS1381/MuteMyMainMenuPleaseMod]Source Code[/url][/size]

Downloads.Description: Fixed issue with sound settings resetting and made some edge cases more rugged

Manifest.Name: Mute My Main Menu Please
Manifest.Description: Fixes the inverted and desynchronized title mute button while preserving custom user volume levels.
Manifest.Author: Arshia1381
